build_escnmd_block: build an eSCNMD_Block for equivariant spherical convolutional neural network message passing with edge and atomwise updates
create_edgewise_module: create an Edgewise module with SO2 convolutions and gate or S2 activation for edge feature transformation
create_spectral_atomwise: create a SpectralAtomwise module using SO3 linear layers and gate activation for spectral atomwise feature updates
create_grid_atomwise: create a GridAtomwise module that projects features to SO3 grid for pointwise MLP operations then back
set_mole_ac_start_index: set the activation checkpointing start index on all MOLE submodules within a given PyTorch module
